# Test captures

Packet captures and byte fixtures used by the decoder tests.

For every file added here, record where it came from and its license:

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `c9200-access-port.pcapng` | Generated by `internal/testframes` (a made-up Cisco C9200L access port: LLDP, one unrelated IPv4 frame, CDP). Regenerate with `go test ./internal/decode -run TestCaptureFile -update`. | MIT, part of JackTrace |

Only add captures from public sources with a clear license, or ones made on the maintainer's own test rig. Never add captures from a workplace or client network.

## Third-party sample captures (not in the repo)

The Wireshark wiki's CDP and LLDP samples (`cdp.pcap`, `cdp_v2.pcap`, `cdp-BCM1100.cap`, `lldp.minimal.pcap`, `lldp.detailed.pcap`, `lldpmed_civicloc.pcap`, `lldp-shutdown-pdu.pcapng`) state no license, so they stay out of git. To cross-check the decoders against them, download them into any local folder and run:

```
JACKTRACE_SAMPLES=/path/to/folder go test ./internal/decode -run TestSamples -v
```

Compare the output with `tcpdump -nn -vv -r <file>` or Wireshark.
